[process narration moved out of reading 2026-09-02] This Vantage Data Centers facility, TX22, shares the Westover Hills campus in Bexar County, Texas, with the neighboring TX21 row, at the crossing of State Highway 151 and Wiseman Boulevard. Local press (San Antonio Report, August 2023) described Vantages purchase of a 31 acre parcel at this crossing, without distinguishing individual buildings by name. The DataCenterMap aggregator directory lists a TX22 entry giving the same 5207 Rogers Road address already recorded for the neighboring TX21 row, this appears to be a shared campus-level address rather than an independently confirmed TX22-specific street number, so it is not asserted as this rows own address this session. No MW or square footage figure was found published for this facility this session. A prior note on this row associated it with Frontier, a Vantage mega-campus announced August 2025. This is corrected here, Vantages own August 2025 press release (tier-1 operator source, https://vantage-dc.com/news/vantage-data-centers-unveils-plans-for-frontier-a-25b-mega-campus-in-texas-to-meet-unprecedented-ai-demand/) states Frontier is a 1,200 acre, 1.4 GW, 25 billion dollar, ten building campus in Shackelford County, Texas, near Albany, roughly 300 miles from San Antonio and Bexar County. Frontier is not the San Antonio area campus this row belongs to, it is a separate, later, and much larger project elsewhere in Texas.
